seasonal_policy: Holidays and atmosphere overlap: Halloween, winter, romance, spring and other themes can share programmes. Horror is marked Evening.
holiday_policy: Annual dates are computed in Europe/London. Christmas rotates throughout December with festive spotlights; other designated specials are pinned to their holiday date. Spring/romance/winter-themed programmes retain their seasonal windows.
